title: $30,000 for In‑Unit Laundry? The Myth Busted

scenes.text: $30,000 could buy a luxury apartment in Manhattan.
Renters who pay $30,000 for in‑unit laundry are saving money.
scenes.label: Laundry Costs Save Money

scenes.text: The average cost of a commercial laundry unit is $30–$50 per month, and most renters already pay a similar amount in rent. The upfront $30,000 purchase is a one‑time expense that reduces long‑term cash flow.
scenes.label: Laundry Costs Don’t Save Cash

scenes.text: Think twice before splurging on appliances you’ll only use once a year.
scenes.label: Use Wisely

scenes.text: Follow for the wealth lessons school skipped.

description: Is a $30,000 in‑unit laundry a smart investment or a cash drain? Find out why the myth fails and how to make better choices. Follow for more money wisdom!
